To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the charge transfer inefficiencies of SCDs are not significantly affected by the proton irradiation.
the CTI of a proton-iradiated SCD is strongly dependent on the operating temperature and the CTI is higher at low operating temperatures.
the CTE of a SCD is affected by the operating temperature.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the CTI of the prototype SCD.
the CTI of a proton-irradated SCD.
the CTI of a SCD, which can be used to evaluate the performance of a SCD and to estimate the lifetime of the HXMT satellite.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the SCD is not sensitive to the proton irradiation.

CTI of the proton-irradiation SCD increases with temperature and is higher at the higher temperatures.

the SCD is very sensitive to proton radiation.

the CTI of the SCD can be measured using this method.
